entities.name: Year Zero
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Year Zero was an idea put into practice by Pol Pot in Democratic Kampuchea that all culture and traditions within a society must be completely destroyed or discarded and that a new "revolutionary" culture must replace it starting from scratch. In this sense, all of the history of nation or people before "Year Zero" would be largely deemed irrelevant, because it would ideally be purged and replaced from the ground up.
